claims.name: Suffragist Ethel Fennings 1876-1955 lived at 149 Croydon Road, Anerley with her like-minded mother & sisters, northeast of our Clocktower-from the plinth of which on Friday evenings she would advocate the just cause of "Votes for Women"

claims.name:
Suffragette Mary Pearson born 1871
lived to the southwest of our Clocktower at
57 Selhurst Road, Croydon active in the
Women's Freedom League, her militancy
in the support of Female Suffrage was
to result in imprisonment in 1908
